title: Staged weight docking + telemetry‑driven pin release (silent canary) for OSS LLMs
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Implement a deterministic 'weight docking corridor' that converts community model artifacts into runtime-compatible builds, runs multi-axis validation (functional, deterministic smoke, perf), and publishes a signed version pin using a telemetry-driven staged release (a 'silent canary' before broad pin availability).
acceptance_criteria: Conversion produces byte-identical runtime bundle for a given conversion profile + deterministic metadata.
Automated validation suite (smoke + regression prompts) passes on conversion in <3 attempts for supported variant families.
Performance profile generated with median latency, p95, token-throughput and unit-cost estimates published to the model catalog UI and runtime.
Signed pin artifact is published to the catalog but marked 'silent-canary' and only routed to <1% traffic via routing policy for 48 hours.
Telemetry gates (error rate, latency, model-quality regressions) are automatically evaluated and trigger rollback to previous pin and notify on-call.
All artifact provenance and KMS-signed manifests stored in the audit log and accessible to compliance team.
description_details:
Planned steps:
1) Artifact docking: add an adaptor to normalize community checkpoints (hf, safetensors, torch) into an internal staging bucket with canonical metadata and manifest.
2) Deterministic conversion: run conversion pipeline in hermetic container with seedable environment to ensure stable output. Record conversion recipe + toolchain metadata.
3) Variant assembly: produce 3 variants (fp16, int8-quant, desktop-optimized) per config, with consistent naming and compatibility matrix.
4) Functional & deterministic validation: run the deterministic-smoke harness (same prompt set, same RNG seeds) and assert token-level diffs are within tolerance for non-quantized flows.
5) Performance profiling: automated runtime benchmarks across target sequence lengths, batch sizes; compute cost-per-token estimate.
6) Quality regression checks: run curated eval prompt sets and compute signal deltas; if delta > threshold mark gating issue.
7) Pin publishing: create a signed pin manifest (KMS/HSM), mark as 'silent-canary', and create release entry.
8) Silent canary rollout: route <1% of production traffic (configurable) and observe telemetry for 48h, with automatic rollback on gate violation.
9) Post-canary: if stable, promote pin to 'public' in catalog and update release notes + benchmarks.
risks_and_mitigation: Conversion non-determinism: mitigate via strict hermetic containers, pinned conversion tool versions, and checksum verification.
Model-quality regressions when quantizing: keep pre-quantized baseline and require per-variant quality delta thresholds; add optional rerun with alternative quantization backend.
Telemetry blindspots during silent canary: ensure synthetic traffic + real traffic blended; add per-customer canary suppression to avoid sensitive data routing.
Key management for pin signing: use customer KMS for Private installs; rotate keys per release window and record in audit logs.

comments: 2025-10-03 — Aisha Patel: Kickoff meeting notes: agreed on deterministic conversion requirement and telemetry gates. Action: Diego to produce an initial container recipe and smoke harness within 2 weeks.

2025-10-16 — Diego Morales: Conversion container initial prototype uploaded (link above). Observed non-deterministic tensor ordering with one HF checkpoint; added permutation normalization step to adaptor.

2025-10-21 — Maria Chen (PM): Trade-off discussion: quantize-by-default reduces cost but increases QA surface. Decided: publish fp16 baseline + optional quantized variants; quantized variants must pass stricter eval thresholds before canary.

2025-10-28 — Diego Morales: Benchmarks for baseline variant: median latency 82ms @ seq=128 on rtx-a500; p95 190ms. Added perf harness changes to record token throughput and memory shadowing traces. PR #982 in review.
2025-11-02 — Security (Ravi Kumar): Reviewed KMS signing plan; requested inclusion of key rotation doc and HSM-backed signing for enterprise private installs. Marked security_review_required: true.

2025-11-08 — QA (Olivia Park): Ran canary smoke with synthetic traffic; saw elevated timeout rate for int8 variant at high parallelism. Action: limit concurrency for int8 in canary and add targeted fallback to fp16 for timeout spikes.
2025-11-11 — Diego Morales: Implemented telemetry gate evaluator and rollback hook. Dry-run against staging shows automatic rollback triggers at error rate >1.5% or p95 latency >2x baseline.
2025-11-12 — Aisha Patel: Requesting design review for catalog UI badge states (silent-canary). Pinged @Design for badge color/accessibility checks.
